---
description: Generated by go42x from .go42x/go42x.yaml; import this agent journal persistence into agentic workflows. It restores
  and saves the journal only when the JOURNAL_REPOSITORY variable names a journal repository as owner/name.
  JOURNAL_REPOSITORY_PATH names this project's folder in a journal repository shared by several projects;
  unset, the journal repository holds only this project's journal.
pre-agent-steps:
  - name: Restore agent journal
    if: vars.JOURNAL_REPOSITORY != ''
    env:
      JOURNAL_REPOSITORY: ${{ vars.JOURNAL_REPOSITORY }}
      JOURNAL_REPOSITORY_PATH: ${{ vars.JOURNAL_REPOSITORY_PATH }}
      JOURNAL_DIR: ".go42x/journal"
      JOURNAL_RETENTION_DAYS: 30
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      folder="${JOURNAL_REPOSITORY_PATH%/}"
      if [ -n "$folder" ] && [[ "/$folder/" == *//* || "/$folder/" == */.* ]]; then
        echo "::error::JOURNAL_REPOSITORY_PATH must be a relative path without empty, hidden, or parent parts, such as go42x; this run neither restores nor saves the journal."
        exit 0
      fi
      clone="$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-journal-restore"
      rm -rf "$clone"
      if ! git clone --quiet --depth 1 "https://github.com/${JOURNAL_REPOSITORY}.git" "$clone"; then
        echo "::warning::The agent journal repository ${JOURNAL_REPOSITORY} cannot be cloned; this run neither restores nor saves the journal."
        exit 0
      fi

      # Only this project's entries are restored: the directories with an entry.json in its
      # folder, or at the top of a journal repository that holds only this project's journal.
      mkdir -p "$JOURNAL_DIR"
      for record in "$clone/${folder:-.}"/*/entry.json; do
        [ -f "$record" ] || continue
        cp -R "$(dirname "$record")" "$JOURNAL_DIR/"
      done

      # Like go42x agentenv journal gc, remove entries without an update for the retention
      # period unless they are kept. The save job then removes them from the repository.
      cutoff="$(date -u -d "-${JOURNAL_RETENTION_DAYS} days" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
      for record in "$JOURNAL_DIR"/*/entry.json; do
        [ -f "$record" ] || continue
        if jq -e --arg cutoff "$cutoff" '.keep != true and .updated_at <= $cutoff' "$record" >/dev/null; then
          echo "Removing expired journal entry $(basename "$(dirname "$record")")"
          rm -rf "$(dirname "$record")"
        fi
      done

      git -C "$clone" rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-journal-base"
post-steps:
  - name: Prepare agent journal handoff
    if: vars.JOURNAL_REPOSITORY != ''
    env:
      JOURNAL_DIR: ".go42x/journal"
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      handoff="$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-journal-handoff"
      rm -rf "$handoff"
      if [ ! -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-journal-base" ]; then
        echo "The agent journal was not restored, so this run does not save it."
        exit 0
      fi

      mkdir -p "$handoff/entries"
      cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-journal-base" "$handoff/base"
      # Only entries, the directories with an entry.json, are saved.
      for record in "$JOURNAL_DIR"/*/entry.json; do
        [ -f "$record" ] || continue
        cp -R "$(dirname "$record")" "$handoff/entries/"
      done
      # Links, Git metadata, and files over 10 MB never leave the runner.
      find "$handoff/entries" -name '.git*' -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
      find "$handoff/entries" ! -type f ! -type d -delete
      find "$handoff/entries" -type f -size +10M -print -delete | sed 's/^/Left out a file over 10 MB: /'
  - name: Upload agent journal handoff
    if: vars.JOURNAL_REPOSITORY != ''
    uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
    with:
      name: agent-journal-handoff
      path: ${{ runner.temp }}/agent-journal-handoff
      retention-days: 1
      if-no-files-found: ignore
jobs:
  save-journal:
    needs: [agent, detection]
    if: vars.JOURNAL_REPOSITORY != ''
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Download agent journal handoff
        id: handoff
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: agent-journal-handoff
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/agent-journal-handoff
      - name: Resolve agent journal repository
        id: repository
        if: steps.handoff.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          JOURNAL_REPOSITORY: ${{ vars.JOURNAL_REPOSITORY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if ! [[ "$JOURNAL_REPOSITORY" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9-]+/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::JOURNAL_REPOSITORY must name a repository as owner/name, such as go42-dev/agent-journal."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "owner=${JOURNAL_REPOSITORY%%/*}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "name=${JOURNAL_REPOSITORY#*/}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Create agent journal token
        id: token
        if: steps.handoff.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3.3.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.AI_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.AI_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ steps.repository.outputs.owner }}
          repositories: ${{ steps.repository.outputs.name }}
          permission-contents: write
      - name: Install gitleaks
        if: steps.handoff.outcome == 'success'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks.tar.gz"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$archive" \
            https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.30.1/gitleaks_8.30.1_linux_x64.tar.gz
          echo "551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb  $archive" | sha256sum --check --quiet -
          tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" gitleaks
      - name: Save agent journal
        if: steps.handoff.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.token.outputs.token }}
          APP_SLUG: ${{ steps.token.outputs.app-slug }}
          JOURNAL_REPOSITORY: ${{ vars.JOURNAL_REPOSITORY }}
          JOURNAL_REPOSITORY_PATH: ${{ vars.JOURNAL_REPOSITORY_PATH }}
          SUBJECT: ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff="$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-journal-handoff"
          folder="${JOURNAL_REPOSITORY_PATH%/}"
          if [ -n "$folder" ] && [[ "/$folder/" == *//* || "/$folder/" == */.* ]]; then
            echo "::error::JOURNAL_REPOSITORY_PATH must be a relative path without empty, hidden, or parent parts, such as go42x."
            exit 1
          fi
          folder="${folder:-.}"
          base="$(cat "$handoff/base")"
          if ! [[ "$base" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}([0-9a-f]{24})?$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::The agent journal handoff names no valid base commit."
            exit 1
          fi

          gh auth setup-git
          repo="$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-journal-save"
          git clone --quiet --filter=blob:none --no-checkout "https://github.com/${JOURNAL_REPOSITORY}.git" "$repo"
          cd "$repo"
          git config user.name "${APP_SLUG}[bot]"
          git config user.email "${APP_SLUG}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          # Concurrent runs append to the same log; keep both runs' lines.
          echo 'log.jsonl merge=union' >> "$(git rev-parse --git-path info/attributes)"
          branch="$(git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD)"
          branch="${branch#origin/}"

          # Replace this project's entries as the restored commit had them, so the commit holds
          # only this run's changes, and entries that other runs added in the meantime stay.
          # Other files of the folder, such as the README of a dedicated repository, stay too.
          git checkout --quiet --detach "$base"
          mkdir -p "$folder"
          for record in "$folder"/*/entry.json; do
            [ -f "$record" ] || continue
            rm -rf "$(dirname "$record")"
          done
          cp -R "$handoff/entries/." "$folder/"
          git add --all -- "$folder"
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The agent journal has no changes to save."
            exit 0
          fi
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks" dir --no-banner --redact --exit-code 1 "$folder"
          # Conventional commit: the project scopes the change in a shared journal repository.
          project="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY#*/}"
          git commit --quiet -m "chore(${project,,}): save journal${SUBJECT:+ for #$SUBJECT} in run ${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"

          # This run's version of a file wins. An entry that this run removed and another run
          # changed stays.
          rebase() {
            git rebase --quiet -X theirs "origin/$branch" >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0
            for _ in $(seq 20); do
              [ -d "$(git rev-parse --git-path rebase-merge)" ] || return 0
              while IFS= read -r path; do
                [ -n "$path" ] || continue
                if git cat-file -e ":3:$path" 2>/dev/null; then
                  git checkout --theirs -- "$path"
                else
                  git checkout --ours -- "$path"
                fi
                git add -- "$path"
              done <<< "$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)"
              if ! GIT_EDITOR=true git rebase --continue >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
                [ -z "$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)" ] && git diff --cached --quiet; then
                # The other runs already made every change of this run.
                git rebase --skip >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
              fi
            done
            git rebase --abort
            return 1
          }
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            git fetch --quiet origin "$branch"
            if rebase && git push --quiet origin "HEAD:$branch"; then
              echo "Saved the agent journal of ${GITHUB_REPOSITORY} to ${JOURNAL_REPOSITORY}."
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep $((attempt * 3 + RANDOM % 5))
          done
          echo "::error::The agent journal could not be pushed to ${JOURNAL_REPOSITORY} after 5 attempts."
          exit 1
---
